config.note: STATIC/D0/E/F from phase2k_sim.run_arm_k; gate, validation scale (200/8w), STATIC identical to 2j. D0: replicates 2j-D (independent validation seeds seed+1000+e*10000 / seed+2000+e*10000, old binary 4 candidates, winner-take-all). E: only change vs D0 is dual-sample confirmation (second sample seeds +5000 each, same gate, no fallback). F: only change vs D0 is fallback rule (first passing candidate in validation order, else veto).
